name: session-strip
description: Publishes each Claude Code session's synopsis (project, task, tools running) for an on-screen strip

useHaiku.title: Summarize the task with Haiku
useHaiku.description: Every few turns, one tiny Haiku call (~$0.0006) rewrites the task line. Off: the task is the first prompt, truncated.

summarizeEvery.title: Re-summarize every N turns
summarizeEvery.description: The task line is first written after turn 1, then refreshed every N turns.
